Sixth New Hampshire Vols.

JOIN US - A New Jersey based Civil War Reenactor Group

We are a great group of friendly and like minded folks who enjoy the outdoors, memorable camaraderie, and have fun with history representing the sixth regiment of New Hampshire volunteer infantry as the premier civil war reenactors group of the North East.
